title: Senior Oracle APEX Developer
requiredSkills: The candidate will have a strong background in Oracle APEX (version 23 or higher), PL/SQL development, and front-end technologies.
The candidate should also possess a proactive attitude, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work independently in a dynamic environment.
Design, develop, test, and deploy Oracle APEX applications (v23 or higher)
Develop and optimize complex SQL and PL/SQL code (procedures, triggers, packages, functions)
Perform performance tuning and optimization of queries and application components
Utilize jQuery, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML to enhance the user interface and user experience
Work with development tools such as SQL Developer and SQL*Loader
Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver effective solutions
Learn and support SnapLogic integration (prior knowledge is an advantage; willingness to learn is required)
Ensure application scalability, maintainability, and performance
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues independently
8–12 years of overall experience in Oracle Development
6–8 years of hands-on experience in Oracle APEX development
Strong expertise in SQL and advanced PL/SQL programming
Proven experience in performance tuning of Oracle applications
Proficiency in web technologies: JavaScript, jQuery, CSS, and HTML
Familiarity with tools such as SQL Developer and SQL*Loader
Experience with or exposure to SnapLogic is a plus
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Self-driven, with the ability to work independently
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
Oracle certifications (if any) are a plus

title: Oracle EBS Developer
requiredSkills: The candidate should have experience in supporting, enhancing, and maintaining Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) applications
Must have strong technical expertise in Oracle EBS development, customization, integrations, and reporting
Must have the ability to work closely with functional teams to deliver scalable solutions
Design, develop, test, and deploy Oracle EBS customizations and extensions
Develop interfaces between Oracle EBS and third-party applications
Create and maintain reports using BI Publisher, Oracle Reports, and SQL
Develop custom PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, and triggers
Support data conversion and migration activities
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions
Perform code reviews and optimize application performance
Collaborate with functional analysts and business users to gather requirements
Prepare technical design documents and maintain development standards
Participate in upgrades, patching, and release deployments
7+ years of Oracle E-Business Suite (R12/R12.2) development experience
Strong expertise in Oracle PL/SQL, SQL, and performance tuning
Hands-on experience with Oracle Forms, Oracle Reports, XML Publisher (BI Publisher), Oracle Workflow, Oracle Alerts, and Oracle Concurrent Program.
Experience developing and supporting interfaces using APIs, Open Interface Tables, and Web Services (SOAP/REST)
Strong knowledge of Oracle Application Framework (OAF) customization and extensions
Experience with Oracle Application Object Library (AOL)
Familiarity with Oracle Application DBA concepts, including patching and deployments
Experience with Shell scripting and Unix/Linux environments
Knowledge of version control tools such as Git
Experience in one or more Oracle EBS modules, including Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA, CM), Procurement (PO, iProcurement), Supply Chain (OM, INV, BOM, WIP), and HRMS (preferred but not mandatory)
Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) is a plus
Experience integrating Oracle EBS with cloud applications
Exposure to higher education or university environments is preferred
Oracle EBS certifications are desirable
Excellent communication and documentation skills

title: Zuora Revenue Architect
requiredSkills: 7+ years’ Order to Cash with Revenue Recognition experience within a professional services/SaaS organization; ideally, at least 3 years in delivering revenue solutions
Experience in working with at least one of the revenue recognition products: Zuora Revenue, Oracle Revenue Management, NetSuite ARM
Excellent knowledge of ASC 605 and 606
Must have knowledge of integration and data flows between CRM, Order Management, Billing, and Revenue systems
Experience with customer-facing solution delivery and/or business consulting experience
Demonstrated ability to lead business discussions with customers, architect solutions, and implement best practices
Experience in requirements gathering, use case documentation, business analysis, systems design and integration, and implementation
Experience in SQL, data analysis, conversion and migration, interfaces, and reports
Must be a strong team player with excellent communication skills at the business and technical levels, able to collaborate with cross-functional teams
Experience managing tasks on multiple projects simultaneously
Able to travel to customer locations as needed
BS/MS degree in Information Systems or Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Work at the enterprise level to deliver revenue solutions and manage end-to-end solution design and delivery in collaboration with the Revenue Accounting team, IT, the Solution Delivery Manager, and Technical Consultants.
Conduct requirements gathering and design workshops to analyze the requirements
Perform FIT/GAP analysis on business requirements and then document gathered requirements/user stories
Design and document functional and technical solutions, including process flows, technical customizations, and integrations, based on customer requirements
Work with the customer to get sign-off on requirements, design, and production roll-out
Configure and test Zuora Revenue, and Add-On products to meet the approved designs
Work with Technical Consultants to explain the requirements to build any custom solutions/integrations
Perform testing of end-to-end solutions in conjunction with the development team and customer
Perform customer demos throughout the project lifecycle
Create and develop training materials and conduct/deliver end-user training to customers
Support the customer with regular calls to answer functional and technical questions
